title: A new asymmetry, an old toolkit: An emerging developmental enigma in appendage evolution
content:
by Caroline Schwaner, Tetsuya Nakamura

Dorsoventral polarity is a key feature of paired appendages, yet its evolutionary origin is enigmatic as median fins, which predate paired appendages, are symmetric. A new PLOS Biology study shows lmx1b is dorsal in paired fin mesenchyme but posterior in median fins, implying genetic rewiring of an ancient toolkit.
